approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Parliamentary Departments.
It would provide about seven-twelfths of the estimated annual funding for those departments for 2022-23.

The remaining five-twelfths of the annual amount was already provided by an earlier supply act, and this bill follows the usual practice of ensuring ongoing government operations without funding new budget measures.
The bill proposes appropriations from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the Parliamentary Departments.
The amount is roughly seven-twelfths of the estimated 2022-23 annual appropriations for those departments.
It excludes funding for new Budget measures, following the convention of supply appropriations.
